name: Alkali Metals
description: Highly reactive, soft metals in Group 1 of the periodic table.

name: Alkaline Earth Metals
description: Reactive, electropositive metals in Group 2 of the periodic table.

name: Transition Metals
description: Metals characterized by partially filled d subshells, variable oxidation states, and colored compounds.

name: Post-Transition Metals
description: Soft metals with low melting points located between transition metals and metalloids.

name: Metalloids
description: Elements with properties intermediate between metals and nonmetals.

name: Reactive Nonmetals
description: Nonmetallic elements that readily form chemical bonds, including halogens and nonmetal life elements.

name: Noble Gases
description: Extremely unreactive, odorless, colorless gases in Group 18 with complete electron shells.

name: Lanthanides
description: Series of 15 metallic elements from lanthanum to lutetium.

name: Actinides
description: Series of 15 radioactive metallic elements from actinium to lawrencium.

name: Unknown Properties
description: Superheavy synthetic elements with unconfirmed macroscopic physical/chemical properties.
